summary: Gun destroyed-failure set/clear (68h / 69h, flags 7 from 0072A054 / 0072A154) also travel through their copies (00728F20 / 00728FA0 constructors, the shared 006D2F20 / 006D1550 scalar codec, IsType 00728F70 / 00728FF0) and the same 0072D830 switch (vtable[1C8h] 0072B5A0, vtable[1CCh] 007280A0). Two further single-player session messages that 0077C2A0 routes to the local queue now travel through their rebuilt copies: MT_GUN_FIRE (ADh, flags 1 from 0072D290 / 0084C625) via 006E3940 / 006E39B0 / 006E39E0 and the gun switch 0072D830, whose ADh arm (vtable[1DCh] FireIfReady) now gates the gunnery pump's FireIfReady; MT_PLANE_DISAPPEAR (C7h, flags 5 from 007CE74F) via 00762B20 / 00762BE0 / 00762C30, whose copy's +20h holder id selects the holder's air-ops block (registry entry bound to id = unit index + 1). Narrow host bases split out (no new bodies): Seg33aGunFireMessageHost from Seg33aHost, GunNetworkMessageHost from Cc13Front3Host. Route-flag survey: 0077C2A0 drops flags exactly 4 unless session mode is 1, so D5h and 95h never reach the local queue in single player.

rows.reason: D5h is routed with 0077C2A0 flags 4 (006F707D); flags exactly 4 is dropped unless game+1FE4h == 1, so single player never queues it (also 006F26B0 / 006F2700 / 006F29D0).
D5h receiver: the message is never delivered in single player (flags 4 at 006F707D); MP host/peer only.
95h is routed with 0077C2A0 flags 4 (00821E13), dropped outside session mode 1; the arm store unit+1124h is already done by the sender (00821DC9). Also 00760F20 / 00760F80.

9Bh is local (flags 7, 0093C676) but its arm 0093AA90 only creates/stops a point effect on the unit's scene node +4A4h; the host has no section effect slots or point effects (00867B10 / 008689C0 recorded). Also 00761630 / 007616A0 / 0093AA90 / 0093A2C0.
8Eh helmsman control is sent only when game+1FE4h == 2 (00816A69), an MP client.
78h formation set goes to peers only (0077C880 -> 0077C7B0); single player has none.
A2h dip/rise sync is broadcast with 0077C7B0 to peers, not routed locally.
71h paratrooper landing pos is sent only when game+1FE4h == 1 (MP host) and +218Ch clear.

A5h is local (flags 7) but carries the pad's 13-bit network id (+1Ch) and the building's (+1Eh); the host's landing pads have no entity id to resolve the copy back to (also 00749D90 / 00749E10 / 00749E40 / 0074B570).
2Bh blackout goes through 00784790 BroadcastExcept, reached only at session mode 1; MP only.
